title: dect_nr: Add endpoint mux dissector table
description:
Add a dissector table for endpoint mux. Add IPv6 and 6LoWPAN.
Add allocations for registered organizations/companies.

Add CVG PDU multiple IE support. Code cleanup in dissect_cvg_pdu()
and dissect_cvg_ie(). Add dissect_cvg_header() and reserved fields.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: @edem.khadiev I think this is a good starting point for adding more endpoint mux dissectors. It's also possible to register custom mux dissectors from Lua plugins.
